sn36.17:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn36.17:1.2: Katamā nu kho bhante vedanā || katamo vedanāsamudayo || katamo vedanānirodho || katamā nirodhagāminī paṭipadā ||
sn36.17:1.3: ko vedanāya assādo || ko ādīnavo || kiṃ nissaraṇan ti || || 4
sn36.17:1.5: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.17:1.9: ayam eva ariyo atthaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā || seyyathīdaṃ
sn36.17:1.11: Yaṃ vedanam paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ vedanāya assādo ||
sn36.17:1.12: Yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo ||
sn36.17:1.13: Yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānaṃ || idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ || || 5
sn36.17:2.1: Atha kho pana bhikkhave mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānam nirodho akkhāto || ||
sn36.17:2.2: Pathamaṃ jhānam samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti || pe || ||
sn36.17:2.3: Khīnāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti || doso niruddho hoti || moho niruddho hoti || || 6
sn36.17:2.4: Atha kho pana bhikkhave mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto ||
sn36.17:2.5: pathamajhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti || la || ||
sn36.17:2.6: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti || doso vūpasanto hoti || moho vūpasanto hoti || || 7
sn36.17:2.9: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā paṭippassaddhā honti ||
sn36.17:2.10: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti paṭippassaddhā hoti ||
sn36.17:2.11: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā patippassaddhā honti || ||
sn36.17:2.12: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā honti || ||
sn36.17:2.13: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti || doso paṭippassaddho hoti || moho paṭippassaddho hoti || || 2
